name: odoo-profiles
description: Manage Odoo Connector profiles in a pane (add, edit, toggle writes, remove) and show which profile each Odoo tool call uses.

profiles_file.title: Profiles file
profiles_file.description: Path of the Odoo Connector profiles.json. Empty means %APPDATA%\odoo-connector\profiles.json on Windows, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (else ~/.config)/odoo-connector/profiles.json elsewhere.
